name: Sheriff Cuskelley
bio: Sheriff Cuskelley of Dickinson came west in 1884 to replevin a pony at Belfield, gather witnesses in Medora for the Moody-Malloy trial, and transport accused horse thieves. In late summer 1884 he went to the Standing Rock agency with Robert Milligan to recover horses stolen from Milligan at Sully Springs.
